$comment: New ambitions (national-strengths spec 5.4) for the western realms: a common pool every realm can draw from (each with a requires that makes it fit), and extras per realm keyed by map realm id. Conditions name other realms by catalogue id. The player reads each goal plainly with its progress; a legacy shows only its name until earned. Legacy budgets follow HER-045 (2.0 points, great 3.0, tolerance 0.6), each with at least one lever the game applies today (IN_PLAY).
